html:
Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo has been president of Equatorial Guinea since August 1979, when he overthrew his uncle Francisco Macías Nguema in a coup.

Trained at the Spanish military academy at Zaragoza, he had commanded the national guard under Macías. He ended the worst of the terror, but kept the country under one-party and then dominant-party rule, winning elections with very large majorities.

The discovery of offshore oil in the 1990s changed his country. The oil boom raised national income sharply, while much of the wealth stayed with the ruling family and most people remained poor. He survived several plots, among them the 2004 mercenary plot, and is the longest-serving president in the world.
sum: Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo has been president of Equatorial Guinea since August 1979, when he overthrew his uncle Francisco Macías Nguema in a coup.
